name: M365Gov-CrossProduct-AlertCorrelation
displayName: M365 Governance - Cross-Product Native Alert Correlation

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Each originating Microsoft alert provider
authoritativeControlOwner.sentinelRole: Correlates existing alerts and routes investigation without replacing native detections.

freshness.expected: Connector-dependent; both alerts must arrive within the one-day query period.

limitations: Correlation requires the same non-empty CompromisedEntity representation.
A shared entity does not prove a common root cause.
The rule does not reproduce native alert logic or inspect prompt content.

missingSourceBehavior.description: No incident is created with fewer than two distinct native product or provider alerts; source health is evaluated separately.

incidentConfiguration.grouping: Group by ActorIdentifier and the native alert IDs for PT6H.

severityRationale: Medium adds multi-product context without overriding either native severity.
falsePositiveGuidance: Validate both alerts refer to the same identity or asset and resolve each detection in its authoritative product.
testQuery: Use two approved test alerts from different native providers with the same CompromisedEntity and timestamps within one hour.
